name: artist-statement
title: Artist sales statement
for_each: select id,name from artists order by name

sections.title: Consigned works
sections.sql: select w.external_id as stock,w.title,w.status,c.consignor,c.ends_on,c.commission_pct,c.agreement_ref from artworks w join consignments c on c.artwork_id=w.id where w.artist_id=$1 order by w.external_id

sections.title: Sales and recorded payments
sections.note: Review the contract and tax treatment before settling. This document does not transfer money.
sections.sql: select s.ref,s.sold_on,s.currency,s.total_cents,s.artist_due_cents,s.artist_paid_cents,s.artist_due_cents-s.artist_paid_cents as balance_cents from sales s join artworks w on w.id=s.artwork_id where w.artist_id=$1 order by s.sold_on

name: condition-report
title: Artwork condition record
for_each: select id,external_id as name from artworks order by external_id

sections.title: Identification and condition
sections.sql: select w.external_id as stock,w.title,a.name as artist,w.medium,w.dimensions,w.location,w.condition_date,w.condition_note,w.provenance from artworks w join artists a on a.id=w.artist_id where w.id=$1

sections.title: Movement history
sections.sql: select moved_on,from_location,to_location,note from movements where artwork_id=$1 order by created_at

name: exhibition-checklist
title: Exhibition checklist and price list
for_each: select id,name from exhibitions order by name

sections.title: Exhibition
sections.sql: select name,venue,opens_on,closes_on from exhibitions where id=$1

sections.title: Works
sections.sql: select w.external_id as stock,a.name as artist,w.title,w.medium,w.dimensions,w.status,w.currency,w.price_cents from exhibition_artworks x join artworks w on w.id=x.artwork_id join artists a on a.id=w.artist_id where x.exhibition_id=$1 order by w.external_id
